lines.speaker: Perchta
lines.text: Me smells bloood. Lots of it! But me sees none. Me heards broooken c-c-clay. But spot no pieces.

lines.speaker: Perchta
lines.text: Fine. Fine, fine work you have done. Little cub.

lines.speaker: Perchta
lines.text: You’ve been obeeedient, little cub.. what a good c-c-cleaner you will becometh… Now go. C-c-clean thy livingth room.

lines.speaker: Perchta
lines.text: Me accepts such a gift, little c-c-cub, Me shall enjoyth it with me sisters much… Now go. C-c-clean thy livingth room.
